name: Firegut Emblem procs on taking melee damage (#13118)
contract: #13118: Firegut Emblem (proc dummies 201178, 312480, 316480, 320480) never procced. Every dummy carries
Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it. Tooltip:
"Taking melee damage", tiers "(5sec. internal cooldown)". Flags 40 (taken melee auto attacks and melee
abilities) as the merged Mok'rash's Circlet row. The record's 5% is kept. spell_proc_chance reads each
loaded entry's chance, which equals the record's ProcChance, and spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each loaded
cooldown. aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision, including the roll, 40000 times on one
synthetic event per check. It procs on being struck by a melee auto attack, being struck by a melee ability
(Heroic Strike 78), at the record's chance; it never procs on being struck by a ranged auto attack, taking a
magic spell (Frostbolt 116), a landed melee auto attack. Before the repair the chance and cooldown lookups
fail with 'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail instead of
